provenance.dataset: SynthRAD2023 Task 1 brain, real files; probe patients only (test set untouched)
provenance.preprocessing: fixed: axial, 192x192, native-grid mask area >= 5%, CT fixed HU window, MR per-volume 1/99 pct
provenance.features: frozen DINOv2 pool4 -> PCA (label-free, both modalities) -> G2 or G3
provenance.metrics_gate: a metric is kept only if same-z vs different-z WITHIN the same centre separates by >= 0.5 SD
provenance.gate: cosine+OT passes iff beats random by >= 1 SD on all 3 draws on every kept metric AND >= z-only
provenance.chance: see the random floor; never compare across cells
